entries.title: Genesis 12:1
segments: And the LORD said to Abram, Go out of your country, and from your kindred, and from your father's house into a land that I will show you.

entries.title: Genesis 12:2
segments: And I will make you a great nation. And I will bless you and make your name great. And you shall be a blessing.

entries.title: Genesis 12:3
segments: And I will bless those that bless you and curse the one who curses you. And in you shall all families of the earth be blessed.

entries.title: Genesis 12:4
segments: And Abram departed, even as the LORD had spoken to him. And Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 12:5
segments: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gained in Haran. And they went forth to go into the land of Canaan. And they came into the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 12:6
segments: And Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, unto the Oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite [was] then in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 12:7
segments: And the LORD appeared to Abram and said, I will give this land to your seed. And he built an altar there to the LORD who appeared to him.

entries.title: Genesis 12:8
segments: And he moved from there to a mountain on the east of Bethel. And he pitched his tent [with] Bethel toward the sea and Hai on the east. And he built an altar there to the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 12:9
segments: And Abram journeyed, going on and pulled up [stakes] toward the south.

entries.title: Genesis 12:10
segments: And there was a famine in the land. And Abram went down into Egypt to stay there, for the famine [was] grievous in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 12:11
segments: And it happened, when he had come near to enter into Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look upon.

entries.title: Genesis 12:12
segments: And it will be when the Egyptians see you, they shall say, This [is] his wife. And they will kill me, but they will save you alive.

entries.title: Genesis 12:13
segments: I pray you, say that you [are] my sister, so that it may be well with me for your sake. And my soul shall live because of you.

entries.title: Genesis 12:14
segments: And it happened when Abram had come into Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman [was] very beautiful.

entries.title: Genesis 12:15
segments: The princes of Pharaoh also saw her and commended her before Pharaoh. And the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

entries.title: Genesis 12:16
segments: And he treated Abram well for her sake. And he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and male servants, and maidservants, and she-asses, and camels.

entries.title: Genesis 12:17
segments: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 12:18
segments: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What [is] this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she [is] your wife?

entries.title: Genesis 12:19
segments: Why did you say, She [is] my sister? And so I was about to take her to me as wife. Now therefore behold your wife. Take [her] and go.

entries.title: Genesis 12:20
segments: And Pharaoh commanded men concerning him. And they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
